name: VAG module addresses (UDS on CAN)
platform: MQB / MEB / late PQ (UDS on CAN)
vehicles: VW/Audi/SEAT/Škoda models whose modules answer UDS on CAN — see opendbc's supported list
author: OpenTune contributors
description: A deliberately small Auto-scan list of VAG diagnostic CAN ids taken ONLY from open, license-compatible projects (opendbc, MIT; VW_Flash, BSD-2-Clause), each entry citing its source. UDS on 11-bit CAN only: the KWP2000 / VW TP2.0 modules of older PQ-era cars are not listed because the Auto-scan engine speaks UDS and OBD only. VAG 'address words' (01, 15, 44, …) are not recorded — no license-compatible source.
sources: commaai/opendbc opendbc/car/volkswagen/fingerprints.py + values.py (MIT; fingerprints @ d714bb4, values @ b3bd79a): FW query over UDS 0x22, VOLKSWAGEN_RX_OFFSET = 0x6A for non-OBD modules
